question: How many titles are in the catalog? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_item

question: What is the email address of the member MARY SMITH? Return: email.
sql: SELECT contact_email FROM member WHERE given_nm = 'MARY' AND family_nm = 'SMITH'

question: What is the loan fee of the title ACADEMY DINOSAUR? Return: loan fee.
sql: SELECT loan_fee FROM catalog_item WHERE item_title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: How many performers have the family name GUINESS? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM performer WHERE family_nm = 'GUINESS'

question: In which language is the title ALIEN CENTER? Return: language name.
sql: SELECT l.lang_label FROM catalog_item c JOIN lang l ON l.lang_key = c.lang_key WHERE c.item_title = 'ALIEN CENTER'

question: List all titles the performer PENELOPE GUINESS appears in. Return: title.
sql: SELECT c.item_title FROM performer p JOIN item_cast ic ON ic.performer_key = p.performer_key JOIN catalog_item c ON c.item_key = ic.item_key WHERE p.given_nm = 'PENELOPE' AND p.family_nm = 'GUINESS'

question: How many titles are in the Horror genre? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM item_genre ig JOIN genre g ON g.genre_key = ig.genre_key WHERE g.genre_label = 'Horror'

question: Which genre has the most titles? If several tie, return all of them. Return: genre name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT g.genre_label, count(*) AS k FROM genre g JOIN item_genre ig ON ig.genre_key = g.genre_key GROUP BY g.genre_label) SELECT genre_label FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Which performer appears in the most titles? If several tie, return all of them. Return: given name, family name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT p.performer_key, p.given_nm, p.family_nm, count(*) AS k FROM performer p JOIN item_cast ic ON ic.performer_key = p.performer_key GROUP BY p.performer_key, p.given_nm, p.family_nm) SELECT given_nm, family_nm FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: In which city and country does the member MARY SMITH live? Return: city, country.
sql: SELECT lo.locality_nm, na.nation_nm FROM member m JOIN residence r ON r.residence_key = m.residence_key JOIN locality lo ON lo.locality_key = r.locality_key JOIN nation na ON na.nation_key = lo.nation_key WHERE m.given_nm = 'MARY' AND m.family_nm = 'SMITH'

question: How many members live in Canada? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM member m JOIN residence r ON r.residence_key = m.residence_key JOIN locality lo ON lo.locality_key = r.locality_key JOIN nation na ON na.nation_key = lo.nation_key WHERE na.nation_nm = 'Canada'

question: How many copies of the title ACADEMY DINOSAUR does branch 1 hold? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stock_unit s JOIN catalog_item c ON c.item_key = s.item_key WHERE c.item_title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR' AND s.branch_key = 1

question: Which employee handled the most loans? If several tie, return all of them. Return: given name, family name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT e.employee_key, e.given_nm, e.family_nm, count(*) AS k FROM employee e JOIN loan l ON l.employee_key = e.employee_key GROUP BY e.employee_key, e.given_nm, e.family_nm) SELECT given_nm, family_nm FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Which genres is the title AFFAIR PREJUDICE in? Return: genre name.
sql: SELECT g.genre_label FROM catalog_item c JOIN item_genre ig ON ig.item_key = c.item_key JOIN genre g ON g.genre_key = ig.genre_key WHERE c.item_title = 'AFFAIR PREJUDICE'

question: What is the total amount charged to the member ELEANOR HUNT? Return: total amount.
sql: SELECT sum(ch.amt) FROM charge ch JOIN member m ON m.member_key = ch.member_key WHERE m.given_nm = 'ELEANOR' AND m.family_nm = 'HUNT'

question: How many titles have the audience rating PG-13? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_item WHERE audience = 'PG-13'

question: What is the average runtime in minutes of titles rated NC-17, rounded to two decimals? Return: average runtime.
sql: SELECT round(avg(runtime_min), 2) FROM catalog_item WHERE audience = 'NC-17'

question: How many titles rated G are in the Children genre? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_item c JOIN item_genre ig ON ig.item_key = c.item_key JOIN genre g ON g.genre_key = ig.genre_key WHERE c.audience = 'G' AND g.genre_label = 'Children'

question: For each audience rating, how many titles have that rating? Return: rating, title count.
sql: SELECT audience::text, count(*) FROM catalog_item GROUP BY audience

question: What is the average loan fee across all titles, rounded to two decimals? Return: average.
sql: SELECT round(avg(loan_fee), 2) FROM catalog_item

question: How many loans have not been returned (they have no return time)? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM loan WHERE returned_at IS NULL

question: Which country has the most members? If several tie, return all of them. Return: country.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT na.nation_nm, count(*) AS k FROM member m JOIN residence r ON r.residence_key = m.residence_key JOIN locality lo ON lo.locality_key = r.locality_key JOIN nation na ON na.nation_key = lo.nation_key GROUP BY na.nation_nm) SELECT nation_nm FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Which title was loaned out the most times? If several tie, return all of them. Return: title, loan count.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT c.item_key, c.item_title, count(*) AS k FROM loan l JOIN stock_unit s ON s.unit_key = l.unit_key JOIN catalog_item c ON c.item_key = s.item_key GROUP BY c.item_key, c.item_title) SELECT item_title, k FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: How many distinct members have borrowed at least one title in the Horror genre? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT l.member_key) FROM loan l JOIN stock_unit s ON s.unit_key = l.unit_key JOIN item_genre ig ON ig.item_key = s.item_key JOIN genre g ON g.genre_key = ig.genre_key WHERE g.genre_label = 'Horror'

question: What is the longest runtime in minutes, and which titles have it? Return: title, runtime.
sql: SELECT item_title, runtime_min FROM catalog_item WHERE runtime_min = (SELECT max(runtime_min) FROM catalog_item)

question: What is the average total charged per paying member (sum of all charges divided by the number of distinct members charged), rounded to two decimals? Return: average.
sql: SELECT round(sum(amt) / count(DISTINCT member_key), 2) FROM charge

question: What is the total of all charges ever made? Return: total amount.
sql: SELECT sum(amt) FROM charge

question: Which member has been charged the most times? If several tie, return all of them. Return: given name, family name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT m.member_key, m.given_nm, m.family_nm, count(*) AS k FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON ch.member_key = m.member_key GROUP BY m.member_key, m.given_nm, m.family_nm) SELECT given_nm, family_nm FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Use the catalog_item table's item_length column to find the runtime in minutes of the title ACE GOLDFINGER. Return: runtime.
sql: SELECT runtime_min FROM catalog_item WHERE item_title = 'ACE GOLDFINGER'

question: Look up the member whose member_name is MARY SMITH and count their loans. Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM loan l JOIN member m ON m.member_key = l.member_key WHERE m.given_nm = 'MARY' AND m.family_nm = 'SMITH'
